Sväng vänster vid korsningen.es: Gira a la izquierda en el cruce

texto: Read signs and understand simple directions in the neighborhood. **Sväng vänster vid korsningen** means «Turn left at the crossing». Read the expression as a unit, identify the main word and use it in a daily situation. If your device has a Swedish voice, listen to the example and repeat it. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
